title: Two Famous Statues and Towers
text:
Big Ben is in London. It is a famous clock tower. The clock is very big. People come to see it every day.

The Statue of Liberty is in New York. It is green and very tall. It was a gift from France. Many people take photos of it.

questions.text: What color is the Statue of Liberty?
Why do people come to see Big Ben?
options: They want to buy a clock
It is a famous place to visit

questions.text: What can we say about the Statue of Liberty?
options: It is an old, small statue
It is an important and well-known statue
It is in a small village

vocabulary.definition: a machine that shows the time

paragraph_translations: Big Ben jest w Londynie. To slynna wieza z zegarem. Zegar jest bardzo duzy. Ludzie przychodza go zobaczyc kazdego dnia.
Statua Wolnosci jest w Nowym Jorku. Jest zielona i bardzo wysoka. Zostala podarowana przez Francje. Wielu ludzi robi jej zdjecia.
